title: Jess K. Recommends Some Art Books
content: (Link to YouTube) Thanks to Jess Karp for shouting out a recommendation forColor and Light: A Guide for Realist PaintersandImaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't Existalong with some other intriguing books.Check outJess Karp's YouTube channel. Her sketchbook tours are inspiring, and I look forward to readingherbook one day.You can also get my bookssigned from my webstore.
